name: f1fantasyapp
description: F1 Fantasy Sports - Full Stack Monorepo

scripts.api:watch: cd api && dotnet watch run --project F1CompanionApi
scripts.api:format: cd api && dotnet csharpier format . && dotnet format style --exclude **/Migrations/** && dotnet format analyzers --exclude **/Migrations/**
scripts.api:format:check: cd api && dotnet csharpier check . && dotnet format style --verify-no-changes --exclude **/Migrations/** && dotnet format analyzers --verify-no-changes --exclude **/Migrations/**
scripts.test:all: npm run web:test && npm run api:test
